primitives.name: Canonical ID Preference Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Canonical Rules - Prefer stable official/open-data IDs over names.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I_{\\text{canon}}': 'canonical identity indicator, dimensionless', 'I_{\\text{name}}': 'name-based identity indicator, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Stable identifiers form a partially ordered set under precedence; name-based identifiers are less reliable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no stable ID exists, fallback to name-based clustering.

primitives.name: Provisional Identity State Transition
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Rookies and UDFAs can enter a provisional identity state until IDs converge.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{\\text{prov}}': 'provisional state flag, binary', 't_{\\text{converge}}': 'time to ID convergence, seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: Provisional state is temporary and resolves upon ID confirmation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If no convergence within T_max, triggers manual review.

layer2.mapping: GSE state machine transitions into a probabilistic holding state until sufficient evidence accumulates.
layer2.telemetry: Time elapsed since initial identity entry and number of conflicting sources.

primitives.name: Hard No-Merge Conflict Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Hard No-Merge Rules - Same name with different DOB/college and no shared external ID.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{\\text{conflict}}': 'conflict detection flag, binary', 'D_{\\text{DOB}}': 'date-of-birth mismatch, days', 'C_{\\text{college}}': 'college mismatch indicator, binary'}
primitives.assumptions: Same name implies potential identity collision unless resolved by metadata.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D_{\text{DOB}} > threshold or C_{\text{college}} = 1 and no shared ID, prevent merge.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's hard constraint enforcement in probabilistic graph matching.
layer2.telemetry: Number of conflicting identity pairs flagged by hard rule violation.
